info.title: ElDokan Customer API
info.description: Implemented catalog plus customer Identity, Account, Wishlist and Phase 2B Cart on WordPress; the api.eldokan.com hostname is a future target. Adapter release 0.6.0. Monetary query bounds are major currency units; Money.amount uses minor units.

servers.description: Planned hostname; not deployed by this release

post.summary: Register a customer and start a session

201.description: Customer created; the response sets the HttpOnly customer session cookie and atomically merges any valid guest Cart.

post.summary: Log in a customer and start a fresh session

200.description: Authenticated; the response sets the HttpOnly customer session cookie and atomically merges any valid guest Cart.

get.summary: Restore the current customer session and refresh CSRF

200.description: Current authenticated customer and a fresh session-bound CSRF token.
Active session invalidated and cookie cleared.

post.summary: Add a visible parent product to Wishlist

200.description: Current Wishlist; changed is false when the item already existed.

delete.description: Removing an item that is not present succeeds with changed=false.

200.description: Current Wishlist and deterministic changed flag.

get.summary: Restore or create the private guest/customer Cart
get.description: Creates an opaque HttpOnly guest Cart session when no customer session exists. Membership is language-independent; prices and stock are recalculated by the server on every response.

200.description: Current Cart plus an in-memory CSRF token for Cart mutations.

post.summary: Add one simple product or exact public variation selection
post.description: Duplicate exact selections are retry-safe and return changed=false. Use PATCH to change quantity.

200.description: Current Cart and deterministic changed flag.

patch.summary: Set an exact positive Cart item quantity

delete.description: Removing an absent item is deterministic and returns changed=false.

200.description: Current Cart and deterministic changed flag.

parameters.description: Requires category slug. att_ID:atr_ID,atr_ID;att_ID:atr_ID. OR within group, AND across groups. At most 5 groups and 10 choices per group. IDs from category filters.

get.summary: Get product detail by stable ElDokan public ID
get.description: A translated product may have a different public ID per language; ?lang selects its translated ID when WPML is active.

CustomerSession.name: wordpress_logged_in_[site-hash]
CustomerSession.description: WordPress-native Secure/HttpOnly customer session cookie. The concrete cookie name is site-specific and is managed by the browser, never frontend JavaScript.

GuestCartSession.name: eldokan_guest_cart
GuestCartSession.description: Opaque Secure/HttpOnly guest Cart ownership cookie. Its value is never exposed to frontend JavaScript or response bodies.

CsrfToken.name: X-ElDokan-CSRF
CsrfToken.description: Session-bound CSRF value returned by customer auth/session or GET /cart. Keep it in memory; required for private mutations.

image.description: Normalized existing Brand taxonomy Thumbnail; null when no valid thumbnail is managed.

rating.description: Customer-facing seller rating; null until the Phase 2 rating system is implemented.

rating_count.description: Customer-facing seller rating count; null until the Phase 2 rating system is implemented.

id.description: Random stable customer identifier; never a WordPress numeric user ID.

csrf_token.description: Session-bound CSRF value; keep in memory and send as X-ElDokan-CSRF for mutations.

valid.description: False when current price/stock/purchasability validation leaves any line not checkout-ready. Cart never reserves stock.

csrf_token.description: Session-bound Cart mutation token; keep in memory and never localStorage.

changed.description: False for a retry-safe duplicate add or removal of an absent item.
False for a duplicate add or removal of an item that was not present.

Error.description: API error (WP validation errors in this namespace included)

ContentLanguage.description: Effective response language after translation fallback.
